description: BUG-150 added backend auto-execution for routed read-only MCP summaries and returns mcp_execution_result, mcp_summary_result, mcp_tool_event, and mcp_result_cards. The Research Assistant chat UI still renders only the MCP route decision and does not show the actual auto-executed summary/result cards, so users cannot verify the tool result from the main chat experience. Fix must render summary-first auto-execution result cards without raw JSON in the main view, keep audit/debug details collapsed, and validate via frontend/API tests.
